body.x: NINEONE (CEO Jeong Won-gyo, www.nineone.com) showcased its “Smart Toy”, an IoT-based brick toy that is compatible with Lego bricks, in the joint pavilion of the Mobile Technology Convergence Center (MTCC) at the world’s best IT technology exhibition ‘CES(Consumer Technology Show) 2016’ which runs Jan. 6-9 in Las Vegas Convention Center(LVCC).

Smart Toy is an IoT-based product that is compatible with Lego bricks. It is also a next-generation toy, combining Lego’s analog sensibility and IT technology. It helps children build their creativity and reasoning skills by allowing them to play with bricks and experience new functions and ideas.
Co-developed with Korea Institute of Science and Technology (KIST), this product is based on user-participatory AR and has been successfully commercialized.

It is fully compatible with Lego’s Duplo bricks, and expresses the five human emotions via digital technology. It provides the ZigBee-based Trigger Network function, and can control smart bricks via smartphones and Bluetooth communication.

The company showcased an assembly-type flat 80 set with bricks in eight colors, and 10 types of smart bricks with various functions, including LED, dot-matrix, sound, cameras, display, and touch. It also introduced a charging system, Android OS-based smart devices, and a smart Lego AR app.

NINEONE CEO Jeong Won-gyo said: “IoT-based smart toys are emerging as a promising future industry. Through this exhibition, we will share smart contents with global companies, introduce more developed products, and communicate with experts in related fields.”

MTCC prepared the joint pavilion at this exhibition and supported related domestic companies’ participation in CES 2016, promoting the ultra-wide 3D convergence industry. It is mainly focused on the competitiveness reinforcement business of new mobile convergence in the global market.

Held annually in January and owned and produced by the Consumer Technology Association (CTA), CES 2016 is the world's largest exhibition to see the latest global trends in electronics and IT industry in one spot.

AVING News has been sending its reporters to CES for 11 years to introduce the new technologies and products. After the local coverage and research, AVING News will hold ‘CES 2016 Review Conference’ in AVING Studio, Korea on January 28th.
